data.title: bn-3s5: stored Teapot flow read and cancellation
data.description: Partial bn-3s5. Review exact stored-flow reads, body window and native reply validation, and exact owned-job cancellation with independent follow-up observation. Focused Rust tests, digest-pinned disposable-loopback conformance, and just check passed. Pinned cancellation covers a terminal job; the pending and racing outcomes are simulated. The pending named-session send, plant macro and macro replay are outside this diff.

data.body: bn-3s5 final review target: HEAD 67b6d977a58132243ba0208621400d01d69a5166, base ba3b75fe41943d2ebfae501c6b5441ac4dbb43ca. Original partial 35d5537 was replayed by Maw sync as 859ebd1; conflict resolution 7bb4dcc kept epoch and re-applied the partial work. Implemented frozen send, --yes macros run (optional --until), schema-only --yes flows replay --macro/--step/--set, and enriched stored-flow reads. DispatchEvidence keeps sent-no-flow (capture off/lost) distinct from NotSent; login/retry flows bind to their step. Validation: focused teapot tests 22 passed; pinned Teapot digest contract tests 4/4 passed (including live send, two-step macro, macro replay, capture-off no-flow, stored read, terminal cancel); just m1-recut-check, cargo fmt, clippy -D warnings, and full just check passed. bn-3s5 final resync: HEAD 47cdb5b5fd1255df49f6789cb0daa46b4b4c3db6, base fdcb1996683524de2f700cd2e71069ba5b2b8bd2. Maw ws sync replayed all three workspace commits cleanly onto fdcb199 (the independently approved show/list/doctor merge), producing 1380b44, 04023fd and 47cdb5b; no conflict and no new commit. Validation after sync: cargo fmt --check clean; clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -D warnings clean; 22 focused teapot_invocation tests passed; all 4 digest-pinned Teapot contract tests passed with /tmp/scourge-bn-1b4-target/debug/teapot; just m1-recut-check passed; full normal parallel just check passed. Dirty state is only untracked .seal/reviews/cr-vprkb6/events.jsonl. Scope and limits are unchanged: M0.7 registry capture for macro_replay remains null and only the tested two-step shape is live-qualified; capture-lost mid-flow is not separately injected; flow heads are rendered text while body windows are exact; destination is derived from the recorded URL; Teapot still offers no durable caller per-send reference. Workspace remains unmerged and unpushed.

[P1] Valid relogin retries are rejected, and capture-lost retry evidence is unreachable. In the frozen Teapot source (6238d5a, sessions/sender.rs), a successful relogin returns the second SessionSent: the top-level hops/StepRun.flow are the retry, while relogin.logged_out_flow names the original send. Here the parser requires logged_out_flow to equal/be among the top-level retry flow(s) (lines 789 and 866), so a real retry is INVALID_NATIVE_OUTPUT. It also requires retried == retry_flow.is_some(), but Teapot sets retried=true even when capture loss leaves retry_flow=null; FlowReference::Missing for retry is therefore dead code. The focused tests fabricate an impossible response by leaving the original flow in the top-level result. Model and test the actual frozen reply shape so the original, login, and retry sends remain bound to the step, including a missing retry flow under INV-41.

[P1] The public API calls body an exact request body, but forwards Teapot's path-source syntax unchanged. In the frozen Teapot contract/source, --body @FILE reads that local file and @@text is the literal @text; --set values have the same @FILE behavior. Because Scourge runs the subprocess at cwd /, a body such as @/etc/hostname or a set value ending =@/path reads host bytes and can send them to the target. This is argv-safe but still a local-file read/exfiltration primitive and violates the API's exact-literal claim. Encode literal leading @ as @@ (including the value part of --set) or use a type that explicitly separates trusted file sources from literal verifier data; add positive tests proving @-prefixed body/edit data cannot open a local file.

[P1] Caller effect bounds are emitted but discarded before semantic validation. sent_request is not given follow, so no-follow can accept multiple hops and --follow N can accept more than N redirects. macro_run receives only until.is_some(), so --until 1 accepts an unmodified two-step completed reply; it cannot prove later steps were not sent or that outcome/NotRun topology matches the requested cutoff. These replies can conceal extra target traffic after the bound has already been violated. Pass the exact limits into the decoders and reject hops/steps/units/outcomes outside them; include negative fixtures for follow overflow and --until 1 returning two sent steps.

The same topology check must reject authoritative false absence: the focused test currently changes a successful captured run to outcome=refused, adjusts units, and expects run_macro() to return Ok(NotSent). Frozen Teapot documents a live run that stops/refuses before its bound as an error envelope, not a successful run result. For an unbounded successful run every step must have been sent; for --until N only steps after the cutoff may be NotRun; a successful replay's preparatory and replayed steps must be sent. Otherwise malformed stdout can become proof that nothing was dispatched.

Concrete frozen-source shapes to cover: (1) successful request retry: sent.flow=9, sent.hops[0].flow=9, relogin.logged_out_flow=3, relogin.retried=true, relogin.retry_flow=9; (2) capture-lost retry: sent.flow=null and final hop flow=null, but relogin.logged_out_flow=3, retried=true, retry_flow=null; (3) macro/replay StepRun has flow=9 with its relogin.logged_out_flow=3 and retry_flow=9. The primary/original request evidence comes from logged_out_flow when a retry occurred; final hops/StepRun describe the retry. Avoid double-counting retry_flow when it is already the final top-level flow.

Concrete safe construction: for a literal body beginning @, prepend one @ before argv (@secret -> @@secret; @- -> @@-). For each --set LOCATION:PATH=VALUE, escape VALUE the same way after the first '=' (json:x=@secret -> json:x=@@secret) while preserving the location/path grammar. A regression can create a readable sentinel file and assert the loopback target receives the literal @... string, never the sentinel bytes; cover send body, send edit, and replay edit. Reject NUL before spawn as InvalidArgument rather than misclassifying it as tool availability.

Concrete checks: send must have 1..=1+follow.unwrap_or(0) hops and a successful result's hops must be complete (native unknown/stopped exits through an error envelope). For run_macro(None), outcome=completed and every listed step must be a sent complete step. For run_macro(Some(n)), steps 1..=min(n,total) must be sent complete, steps >n must be not-run with null flow/status, units must equal the sent prefix, and outcome is until iff n<total (completed only when n reaches the last step). For successful macro replay, every preparatory step and the replayed step must be sent complete; outer id/status must match the replayed final send. Retain refused/unknown/stopped evidence in typed InvocationError paths rather than accepting an impossible success envelope as NotSent.

data.reason: Exact target 47cdb5b passes all declared gates but has three P1 contract/safety defects: actual frozen relogin retry shapes are rejected and capture-lost retry evidence is unreachable (th-3dpbxz); literal body/edit values can invoke Teapot @FILE reads from the host (th-336x97); and send/macro effect limits plus successful-reply topology are not validated, allowing extra traffic or false NotSent evidence (th-3rh4jz).

data.body:
[P1] Fixed at 9504992 (final HEAD e0b26ce, base 54a567b). Read the frozen source first: 6238d5a crates/teapot-engine/src/sessions/sender.rs:324-325 sets used.retried and used.retry_flow = first_flow(&second), :345 returns `second` with used.relogin, :170 sets logged_out_flow from the first send's logged-out detection; crates/teapot-engine/src/commands/macros_run.rs:1254 and :1245 take StepRun.flow from answered.replayed.hops.first(); crates/teapot-api/src/commands/requests.rs:407-412 take RequestSent.flow from the first hop and status from the last.

Parser changes (crates/scourge-core/src/teapot/send.rs):
- relogin(): removed `retried != retry_flow.is_some()`. Only `!retried && retry_flow.is_some()` is contradictory now, so retried=true with retry_flow=null parses and FlowReference::Missing for the retry is reachable, not dead.
- sent_request(): retried => `retry_flow == flow` (both the retry) and logged_out_flow must NOT be one of the retry's hops or login flows; not retried => logged_out_flow must be one of this send's hops (first request or followed redirect). Real retries are no longer INVALID_NATIVE_OUTPUT.
- step_run(): retried => `retry_flow == StepRun.flow` and logged_out_flow != flow. Not retried, logged_out_flow is left as reported because a step row carries only the first hop's flow and a logged-out redirect hop cannot be checked.
- ReloginUsed::original()/retry() and the flows() of SentRequest and StepRun emit the original (logged_out_flow), each login flow, then the retry once as FlowRole::Retry; a retry with no flow is FlowReference::Missing. A retry's own redirects are FlowRole::Redirect, so nothing is double counted.

Frozen-shape regressions (crates/scourge-core/tests/teapot_invocation.rs):
- send: (1) flow=9, hops[0].flow=9, logged_out_flow=3, retried=true, retry_flow=9 => dispatch Flow{9}, flows [Request 3, Login 7, Retry 9]; (2) flow=null, hops[0].flow=null, logged_out_flow=3, retried=true, retry_flow=null => dispatch NoFlow{Complete}, was_sent() true, is_not_sent() false, flows [Request 3, Login 7, Retry Missing]; (3) retry + followed redirect => [Request 3, Login 7, Retry 9, Redirect 10].
- macro: StepRun flow=9, logged_out_flow=4, retried=true, retry_flow=9, login_flows=[7,8] => dispatch Flow{9}, flows [Request 4, Login 7, Login 8, Retry 9, step2 Request 5]; capture-lost retry (flow=null, retry_flow=null) => NoFlow + Retry Missing; retry_flow=10 with flow=9 => rejected.
- Rejected: retry_flow != reply flow, logged_out_flow == retry_flow (double count), retry_flow set with retried=false, and a non-retried logged_out_flow outside the send's hops.

Validation on the final tree: cargo fmt --check clean; clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -D warnings clean; 23 focused teapot_invocation tests passed; 5/5 digest-pinned tests passed with SCOURGE_PINNED_TEAPOT=/tmp/scourge-bn-1b4-target/debug/teapot (sha256 6d15d625e10afa768a221f64eb7a2a245a64a7babbe61cf74ce8d4ff33b2f458, matching fixtures/contracts/manifest.json); just m1-recut-check; full parallel just check. Limit: the login-shared/capture-lost retry variants are mock-tested, because the real fixture does not rotate a session to logged-out.

[P1] Fixed at 9504992 (final HEAD e0b26ce, base 54a567b). Confirmed the frozen encoding in 6238d5a before editing: crates/teapot-core/src/edit/parse.rs:417-437 `resolve` — `@@x` is the literal text `@x`, `@-` is standard input, `@path` is a file read through the caller's SourceReader; parse_body (:232) and the value part of --set after the first '=' (json :134-137, form/query/cookie :159-168) both go through it. crates/teapot-engine/src/commands/requests.rs:584-641 `localize` only rewrites relative `@FILE` to absolute, so an absolute `@/etc/hostname` was passed through unchanged. parse_header (:204-210) never calls resolve, so --header values were and stay literal.

Encoding now applied in crates/scourge-core/src/teapot/send.rs:
- literal_argument(): a value that starts with `@` gains one `@` (@secret -> @@secret, @- -> @@-, @@x -> @@@x, @ -> @@), which is exactly the supported literal contract.
- body_argument() uses it for --body; edit_argument() splits at the first '=' and escapes only the value, so `json:x=@secret` -> `json:x=@@secret` while the location/path grammar is preserved, including a value that legitimately starts with '-' (json:qty=-1 still works).
- Applied to send's --body and --set and to replay's --set. --header is untouched because Teapot never resolves a header as a source, and escaping it would corrupt a legitimate literal '@' header.
- value_argument() now rejects NUL with InvocationError::InvalidArgument before spawn, so it is a usage error (exit 2) instead of a spawn failure misread as tool availability.

Witnesses:
- New focused test `literal_body_and_edit_values_are_never_teapot_file_sources`: writes a readable sentinel, then asserts the recorded argv carries `@<sentinel>` as `@@<sentinel>` for --body and `json:note=@@<sentinel>` for --set (and for replay's --set), and that the bare `@<sentinel>` never appears; repeats for @-, @@x and @; then asserts a NUL body/edit/header is UsageError and that the `requests send` branch never ran.
- New digest-pinned live test `pinned_follow_until_and_literal_at_values_match_the_frozen_replies` against the real 6238d5a binary (sha256 6d15d625...2f458): the loopback target receives the literal bytes `@<readable sentinel>`, `@/scourge-witness-does-not-exist`, `@-` and `@@x` as the request body, and `{"note":"@/scourge-witness-does-not-exist"}` for both a send --set and a replay --set. The nonexistent absolute path is the negative witness: unescaped, Teapot would have tried to read it and exited 1; escaped, the send succeeds and the target sees the text, so no local file read occurred.

Validation on the final tree: cargo fmt --check; clippy -D warnings; 23 focused tests; 5/5 pinned tests with the digest-pinned binary; just m1-recut-check; full parallel just check.

[P1] Fixed at 9504992 (final HEAD e0b26ce, base 54a567b). The decoders now receive the caller's exact limits instead of a flag.

Frozen authority for each rule (6238d5a):
- requests send: crates/teapot-engine/src/commands/requests.rs:529 sets send.follow = args.follow, and outcome_exit (:345-371) returns Err for any hop that is not complete, or for a stop before a redirect hop, so a successful reply has 1..=1+follow complete hops.
- macros run: crates/teapot-engine/src/commands/macros_run.rs:199-211 last_step makes `--until u` a usage error unless 1 <= u <= steps, and steps 1..=u are sent while the rest are `not-run`; crates/teapot-engine/src/macros/run.rs:1277-1324 turns a stop, an unknown outcome, a challenge or a logged-out answer into a CommandError for the whole run.
- flows replay --macro: every preparatory step is run fresh and the replayed step is run after the edits, so a success sends 1..=step.

Enforced in crates/scourge-core/src/teapot/send.rs:
- sent_request(evidence, session, follow): hops.len() in 1..=1+follow.unwrap_or(0), every hop outcome == complete. Extra hops past the caller's bound, and `unknown`/`stopped` rows, are now InvalidNativeOutput instead of being accepted.
- macro_run(evidence, name, session, until): unbounded => outcome completed and every step complete; `--until N` => 1 <= N <= steps, steps 1..=N complete, steps >N exactly `not-run` with null flow and null status, units == N, and outcome is `until` iff N < steps else `completed`.
- macro_replay: every preparatory step and the replayed step must be complete, in addition to units == step and outer id/status matching the replayed step.
- The old focused test that rewrote a captured success to outcome=refused, adjusted units and expected Ok(NotSent) is gone: that reply is now a typed InvalidNativeOutput. Nothing in a success envelope can prove "nothing was dispatched" except a step past the caller's --until, which is DispatchEvidence::NotSent{NotRun}.

Negative fixtures added: send with 2 hops and follow=None; hop outcome unknown and stopped; macro finished/unbounded with refused, not-run, stopped, unknown or failed on step 1 and on step 2; a flow on a not-sent step; `--until 1` returning two sent steps; `--until 1` with outcome=until and both steps sent; `until` outcome without the bound; `--until 2` on the reply a `--until 1` run produced; steps past the bound carrying a flow and status; `--until 3` on a 2-step macro.

Live coverage added (pinned_follow_until_and_literal_at_values_match_the_frozen_replies, digest-pinned 6d15d625...2f458): a real /chain -> /redirect -> /probe chain gives exactly 1 hop with no --follow, 2 hops with --follow 1 and 3 with --follow 2, all accepted; a real `--until 1` on a two-step macro gives outcome until, units 1, step 1 captured and step 2 NotSent{NotRun}, and the same macro unbounded gives completed with both steps captured. The rejection paths cannot be produced by the real binary (that is the point), so they are fixture-driven.

Validation on the final tree: cargo fmt --check clean; clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -D warnings clean; 23 focused teapot_invocation tests; 5/5 digest-pinned tests; just m1-recut-check; full parallel just check.

bn-3s5 review target: HEAD e0b26ce0888311723a2bf711a5776a38ad129c96, base 54a567b79d7369cc2e2de4dd591b3eab239df04c (current main). The exact previous target 47cdb5b5fd1255df49f6789cb0daa46b4b4c3db6 was preserved first, then Maw sync replayed the workspace onto the new epoch; the rebase conflicted only in four dependency files (Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, crates/scourge-core/Cargo.toml, scripts/check-dependency-pins.py) on the base64 pin, and maw ws resolve --keep epoch kept the reviewed epoch pins so those four files are now byte-identical to main and contribute nothing to the diff.

Commits in range: 98bcfca (stored flow read + cancel, previously reviewed), b99731a (earlier sync resolution), 39a4483 (send / macro / replay / no-flow, previously reviewed), 9e6e164 (carry the cr-vprkb6 event log through the sync), 9504992 (this fix), e0b26ce (structured conflict resolution keeping the epoch pins). Only the last three are new since 47cdb5b.

Scope of this change: exactly the three P1 threads, no more. th-3dpbxz real relogin/retry reply shapes and retry capture loss as FlowReference::Missing; th-336x97 literal @-prefixed body/edit values kept literal instead of Teapot @FILE host reads, plus NUL before spawn; th-3rh4jz requested --follow and --until effect bounds and successful-reply topology so extra traffic and false NotSent are rejected. Named-session send, macro/replay, flow read, cancel, bounds and no-flow semantics are unchanged.

Validation on e0b26ce: cargo fmt --all -- --check clean; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings clean; 23 focused teapot_invocation tests passed; all 5 digest-pinned tests passed with SCOURGE_PINNED_TEAPOT=/tmp/scourge-bn-1b4-target/debug/teapot (sha256 6d15d625e10afa768a221f64eb7a2a245a64a7babbe61cf74ce8d4ff33b2f458 = fixtures/contracts/manifest.json), including the new pinned_follow_until_and_literal_at_values_match_the_frozen_replies; just m1-recut-check passed; full normal parallel just check passed; no test was serialized or weakened.

Limits, unchanged unless stated: the M0.7 registry capture for macro_replay is still null and only the tested two-step shape is live-qualified; capture-lost mid-flow is not separately injected (the capture-off send is live, the capture-lost retry and login-shared variants are fixture-driven); flow heads are rendered text while body windows are exact; destination is derived from the recorded URL; Teapot exposes no durable caller per-send reference beyond the nullable flow ID. New limit from this change: a step row carries only the first hop's flow, so a non-retried logged_out_flow that came from a followed redirect is recorded as reported rather than cross-checked.

Threads th-3dpbxz, th-336x97 and th-3rh4jz are replied with exact evidence and left open for reviewer resolution; the review is retargeted to this HEAD and base with fresh votes required. Nothing was requested, voted, closed, merged, pushed, released or destroyed, and the bone stays doing.

Correction to the target above, and the final state: after that comment I found one more sync artefact and fixed it, so the final target is HEAD 39913ba41e67b928afa7c6c7e5e5967088e9fc0c on base 54a567b79d7369cc2e2de4dd591b3eab239df04c.

The extra commit 39913ba is docs only: the epoch pins `base64 = "=0.22.1"` (for the Investigation evidence bridge) while this branch's earlier commits had added a docs/dependencies.md row for `base64 0.23.1`. Keeping the epoch pin, as the structured conflict resolution required, left that one row stale, so it now reads 0.22.1 and describes the stored-body use. No code, test or pin changed. `rg 0.23.1` is now empty outside target/, and just check still passes on 39913ba.

The three P1 threads are replied with evidence against 9504992, which is unchanged in 39913ba (the only delta from e0b26ce is docs/dependencies.md). Working tree is clean except `.seal/reviews/cr-vprkb6/events.jsonl`, which the Edict clean check excludes.

[P1 remains at exact target 39913ba] The basic retry and Missing-flow cases are repaired, but relogin() still rejects a real frozen reply shape. It derives ran solely from action and only permits ran=true for re-logged-in/login-failed/login-stopped. Frozen sender.rs first builds used from the login result, then after the retry is answered logged-out again it changes used.action to paused while preserving ran=true, login_flows, login_job, retried=true and retry_flow. This is not hypothetical: fixtures/contracts/channel-observed.txt session-GET records action=paused, ran=true, paused=true, reason=logged-out-again, logged_out_flow=10, login_flows=[11], retried=true, retry_flow=12. The current ran_matches_action check rejects that exact reply as INVALID_NATIVE_OUTPUT before the corrected original/login/retry topology is used. Accept the frozen paused-after-retry shape without weakening impossible combinations, and add a regression using that recorded envelope for send plus the equivalent StepRun binding. Preserve Request=logged_out_flow, Login=login_flows, Retry=final flow and the already-correct Missing retry case.

[P1 remains at exact target 39913ba] Body and equals-form edits are escaped, and NUL is rejected, but edit_argument only escapes text after split_once(=). Frozen teapot-core edit/parse.rs permits path and method edits without equals: both call resolve(rest.strip_prefix(=).unwrap_or(rest), reader). Therefore path:@/etc/hostname and method:@/path reach Teapot as bare @FILE sources in both send and replay; the current focused/live tests cover only json:note=@... and miss these supported forms. This retains the host-file read/exfiltration primitive. Parse enough of the frozen edit grammar to identify the resolved value for path:/method: with or without optional equals, escape a leading @ there, and keep source-free operations such as json-remove/cookie-remove unchanged. Add readable-sentinel and nonexistent-path regressions for no-equals path/method edits on send and replay, proving literal target input and no local read.

[P1 remains at exact target 39913ba] Exact follow/until counts and complete prefixes are now checked, but the NotRun suffix is not authoritative yet. macro_run only requires outcome=not-run with null flow/status after the cutoff. step_run still accepts class, reason, set, withheld, csrf_refreshed and especially relogin on such a row; StepRun::flows then emits Login flows for a step that run_macro simultaneously exposes as NotSent{NotRun}. Concrete accepted false topology: --until 1, two steps, step 2 outcome=not-run and flow/status=null, plus relogin action=reported, ran=false, login_flows=[77], logged_out_flow=null, retried=false, retry_flow=null. Units/outcome/state_changing still pass, but MacroRun::flows reports step-2 flow 77 past the effect bound. Frozen macros/run StepReport::new makes an unrun row class/reason/relogin null and set/withheld/csrf empty; method/url/state-changing/compute/references may remain declaration metadata. Enforce that exact live NotRun suffix and add adversarial fixtures, including relogin/login flow and nonempty effect-derived fields after N. The already-added count and native error-envelope checks can remain.

Formatting, clippy, 23 focused tests, 5/5 digest-pinned live tests, m1-recut, full normal parallel just check, and diff checks pass, but they do not cover these adversarial frozen-valid/malformed shapes.

data.body:
[P1] Fixed at 1610e94 (base 54a567b79d7369cc2e2de4dd591b3eab239df04c). Read the frozen sender before editing: crates/teapot-engine/src/sessions/sender.rs:168-183 relogin_used sets `ran: handled.ran` and `action: handled.action`, and after the retry is itself answered logged-out again :324-341 sets `used.retried = true`, `used.retry_flow = first_flow(&second)` and then, when `then.paused`, `used.paused = true`, `used.action = PAUSED_ACTION`, `used.reason = ...` without touching `ran`, `login_flows`, `login_job`, `logged_out_flow`, `retried` or `retry_flow`. So `action=paused` with `ran=true` is exactly what the sender writes on the paused-after-retry path.

Parser change (crates/scourge-core/src/teapot/send.rs, relogin()): the derived rule `ran == matches!(action, re-logged-in|login-failed|login-stopped)` is gone. The only action/ran pair the frozen sender cannot write is `login-shared` with `ran=true`: crates/teapot-engine/src/sessions/login.rs:345-349 allows_retry, :620-628 `decided` returns `Handled::new(LOGIN_SHARED)` with `ran=false`, and `GenState.last` (:718, :781) is only ever written from run_login/decided, never LOGIN_SHARED. So `if ran && action == LoginShared { return None; }` and every other action may carry either value. The other frozen values the old rule guessed wrong are now right too: login.rs:657-666 `decided_locked` copies the last action with `ran=false` and empty flows (a waiter), and login.rs:788-795 `Ended::CannotRun` sets `ran=true` over the paused/reported handl.

Added tightening, not a relaxation: a retry is only reached after allows_retry() (re-logged-in/login-shared) or through the paused-after-retry branch, so `retried=true` with any other action (login-failed, login-stopped, reported) is now rejected.

Evidence (tests/teapot_invocation.rs):
- The recorded envelope is read from the repo fixture rather than typed in: `recorded_relogin("session-GET ")` parses fixtures/contracts/channel-observed.txt line 6 and asserts action=paused, ran=true, paused=true, retried=true before use (logged_out_flow=10, login_flows=[11], retry_flow=12 in that record).

- `teapot-api` crates/teapot-api/src/commands/sessions.rs:152-157 defines `re-logged-in` as "this send ran the login" and `login-shared` as another send's login, so the pair you flagged contradicts the published schema as well.
